headline: Enforcement order for grading and fill along Connecticut River banks at 5 Appleton Street.
summary: Fill sediment and debris were seen eroding down the steep bank toward the water. The agenda also includes a draft rare species habitat map open for public comment.
items: Enforcement order for 5 Appleton Street (MBP: 049-01-006), continued from 7/9/26
Draft Priority Habitat Map of Rare Species available for public comment
Temporary ad-hoc committee to study potential impacts of commercial data center development in Holyoke
Mail and other items not reasonably anticipated by the chair
